setup: Open a folder, start a local web server, and turn on this setting.
open: Paste a file link into Quick Open: it offers to open it. Press Enter: the file opens here, on line three.
side: From the README, paste the same link and press Option Enter: it opens beside it, and the README stays.
handlers: For a localhost link, with the shared setting on, the side button opens it in the integrated browser, next to the README.
address: In its address bar, the link keeps its query and fragment.
reuse: A second localhost link, with the side button again, opens as a new tab in that same browser group. The README stays visible.
prefixes: File names still work, even with a line number. So do prefixes, like commands and symbols.
invalid: A malformed link shows Invalid Link, and Enter does nothing.
missing: A link to a missing file reports that the file wasn't found. Cancel closes it.
